resources.string: Choose VK Calls or experimental MAX, then add the credentials needed for that transport.
Uses an anonymous VK Calls invite and supports an in-app CAPTCHA flow.
Uses your phone-linked MAX account to start a short-lived call and acquire TURN credentials. This is attributable to that account and may briefly ring the target.
On: KindlyVPN attempts VK verification in the background. Off: the verification page opens for you to complete manually.
Use an active https://vk.com/call/join/… or https://vk.ru/call/join/… invite. The link remains usable until the call is ended for everyone.
Uses SRTP-shaped encrypted packets and bonds each persistent download across up to ten active TURN sessions.
Experimental: bonds each connection across up to 16 TURN sessions. It may trigger extra provider checks and uses more battery, mobile data and allocations. Changes apply when you reconnect.
